  3. <fidel-event-card>

<fidel-event-card>

Live session card. A live session with its access support in words, "Request access support", "Add to calendar" and, later, the recording.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Deaf, hard-of-hearing and blind learners deciding whether they can follow a live class, and asking for the support they need.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-event-card title="Office hours: how to present"
  start="2026-11-20T19:00:00+03:00" end="2026-11-20T20:30:00+03:00"
  join-url="https://meet.example.org/office-hours" captions="yes"
  sign-language="on-request" languages="en,am" event-id="ev1"></fidel-event-card>

Source: player/src/components/d/event-card.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-event-card>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
titletextnoneThe session's name.
start, endISO 8601 with a time zonenoneWhen it is.
join-urlURLnoneThe live link; shown from 15 minutes before the start until the end.
captionsyes, nononeLive captions.
sign-languageyes, no, on-requestnoneEthiopian Sign Language interpreter.
languagescomma-separated codesnoneSpoken languages, e.g. en,am.
recording-urlURLnoneAfter the end: "Watch the recording".
request-urlURLnoneWhere access requests are POSTed as JSON {eventId, needs, other?}.
reply-byemailnoneThe card says "The organisers will reply by email".
event-idtextnoneId used in events and the .ics file.
heading-level2 to 63Level of the component's heading, so it fits your page's outline.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-event-card>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-event-request{ eventId, needs, other? }The learner asked for access support.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • "Request access support" asks only which support is needed, never why.
  • "Add to calendar" downloads an .ics file made in the browser.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English. Date and time are in both calendars.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: A heading and a description list; access needs are a labelled group.
  • 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Buttons at least 44 × 44 px.
  • It also puts a schema.org Event in JSON-LD on the page.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
